Name: Nyapu's Portraits for Seasonal Cute Characters for East Scarp (Jasper only)
Author: susurrusshivers
Description:
I really love the Seasonal Cute Characters for East Scarp mod by Poltergeister, and I adore Nyapu's portraits. As there is already a seasonal version of Nyapu's portraits for East Scarp and only basic portraits for Jasper, I decided I would make some adjustments to Nyapu's original portraits for Jasper so they work with the seasonal variations included in Poltergeister's optional files.

All credit goes to Nyapu and Poltergeister for their mods, I simply made a few edits so they work together and created missing portraits off of Nyapu's art.

For everything to work properly, download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5599]Professor Jasper Thomas[/url] by lemurkat and place in your Mods folder for Stardew Valley. Then download Nyapu's portraits for Jasper in the optional files of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits[/url] and drag those files into the folder for the Jasper mod and let it overwrite the portraits in both the Original folder and Nin folder. Then download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045]Seasonal Cute Characters for East Scarp[/url] (specifically the Jasper file in the optional files) and place in your Mods folder. Lastly, download my mod and place it into the Seasonal Jasper folder so it overrides the portraits there.

Hope you enjoy; please let me know if you have any issues.
